reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that processes LLM usage events into cost projections, renders per-turn and session cost statistics, and optionally refreshes pricing through web search and LLM extraction.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 计算并展示每个步骤、每轮对话及整个会话的 LLM 成本，并可通过联网搜索和模型抽取更新价格表。
summaries.en: Calculates and displays per-step, per-turn, and session-level LLM costs in DeepSeek Harness, with optional pricing updates through web search and LLM extraction.

capabilities: Reads session events and LLM token usage
Calculates and aggregates per-step, per-turn, and session LLM costs
Displays cost and token statistics in the chat interface
Searches the web for current model pricing
Calls an LLM to extract pricing data
Writes pricing overrides to a local file
